text:
Insko leaving Rep. Levy to join Sen. Nash’s team
Published 9:26 pm Wednesday, October 15, 2025
ENTERPRISE — State Rep. Bobby Levy, R–Echo, announced Monday, Oct. 13, that her chief of staff, Isaac Insko, will be departing her office to join the team of Sen. Todd Nash, R-Enterprise.
“I want to extend my heartfelt congratulations and deepest thanks for the hard work, leadership and dedication shown during Isaac’s time in my office,” Levy said. “It’s been a privilege to work alongside someone so committed to serving the people of House District 58. I wish him the best of luck and the most success life has to offer as he takes on this exciting new role with Sen. Nash.”
Isaac has worked alongside Levy in multiple capacities over the past few years, beginning as an intern in her legislative office, then continuing on with her reelection campaign, helping with her nonprofit the Eastern Oregon Women’s Coalition, and later as her policy analyst and chief of staff.
Throughout this time, Insko also completed his bachelor’s degree from Eastern Oregon University, exemplifying a strong work ethic and dedication to both public service and personal growth.
Nash represents District 29, which covers the northeasternmost area of Oregon. He is the first senator from Enterprise in more than a half-century. He was not available for comment Monday.
To ensure a smooth transition, Levy also announced Monday that Whitley Sullivan, who has served as her communications director this past year, will step back into the role of chief of staff effective Nov. 1.
“Whitley has been an integral part of our team for several years and brings strong experience and steady leadership to the position,” Levy said. “I have full confidence in her ability to continue managing our office with professionalism and heart.”
